messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] Access to development version of roxygen
messages.subject_clean: [Roxygen-devel] Access to development version of roxygen
messages.body_plain:
Hi

I was hoping to get hold of the devel version of roxygen as I am having a similar problem 
to that identified in the recent "Missing quotes in default arguments" thread. I've tried 
the following:

$ svn checkout svn://svn.r-forge.r-project.org/svnroot/roxygen
svn: Can't connect to host 'svn.r-forge.r-project.org': Connection refused

The link from here: http://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/?group_id=183 gives me "Page not found".

Any help appreciated!

Thanks

Richard


--

Apologies, I've just tried accessing off-campus and the svn command worked fine, so seems 
like there's a problem with the access at my end.

Also, I gave the wrong URL before - it is the link to The Nightly SVN Tree Snapshot 
(http://r-forge.r-project.org/snapshots.php?group_id=183) that gives me "Page not found" 
(both on- and off-campus).

Thanks for your help, happy oxygenizing!

Richard

messages.body_plain:
Hi, 

Is there something in Roxygen that can be used to get a skeletic roxygen documentation for an object. I am thinking something similar to prompt, but generating roxygen comments instead of Rd file. If not, I'd probably be interested in contributing something. 

Romain

--
